backend/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import gc,importlib.util,pathlib,statistics,sys,time
sys.path.insert(0,'backend')
p=pathlib.Path(pathlib.Path('/tmp/floorplan-cold-path').read_text())/'before'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('warm_reference',p/'__init__.py',submodule_search_locations=[str(p)])
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);sys.modules[spec.name]=module;spec.loader.exec_module(module)
from warm_reference import analyzer as old,schemas as oschemas,analysis_cache as ocache
from app import analyzer as new,schemas as nschemas,analysis_cache as ncache
from benchmarks.performance import fixtures
for name,data in fixtures():
 if name not in ('sample-110-rooms','sample-550-rooms'):continue
 masks=[s.MaskFile.model_validate(data) for s in (oschemas,nschemas)]
 settings=[s.AnalysisSettings(ceiling_height_m=3.1,door_height_m=2.2) for s in (oschemas,nschemas)]
 for mod,mask in zip((old,new),masks):mod.clear_geometry_cache();mod.analyze(mask)
 assert [entry[1] for entry in ocache.cache._entries.values()]==[entry[1] for entry in ncache.cache._entries.values()]
 samples=[[],[]]
 for rep in range(51):
  for i in ((0,1) if rep%2==0 else (1,0)):
   gc.collect();gc.disable()
   try:
    start=time.perf_counter_ns();result=(old,new)[i].analyze(masks[i],settings[i]);elapsed=(time.perf_counter_ns()-start)/1e6
    samples[i].append(elapsed);del result
   finally:gc.enable()
 print(name,'warm (GC collected before timing, disabled only while timed), 51 pairs: %.3f -> %.3f ms; cache bytes identical'%tuple(statistics.median(s) for s in samples),flush=True)
